title: Chapter 290 Nobility Under The Wheel
content:
Chapter 290 Nobility Under The Wheel

Such a person would not believe that Zhong Yu was a weak, incompetent, wristless waste.

You know, Zhong Yu was in the Three Kingdoms world, but he had slaughtered the entire Yizhou gentry, and he did not hesitate to kill millions of people for this. Then in Jingzhou, the great torture of crossing the river was created, and after the unification of the world, several northern expeditions to Xianbei turned the grassland into a desolate dead zone with no living things for thousands of miles. It is a ruthless character who created an excessive enfeoffment chaos, killed countless civilians of the family, and sacrificed tens of millions of people for this.

How could it be possible to be afraid of the threat of more than ten thousand literati and warriors in this area.

In his eyes, these so-called threatening noises are nothing more than clowns who can't make it to the stage.

Real strength, real threat, vulnerable.

So he directly ordered his army, driving thousands of chariots, roaring out of the barracks, directly crossing the literati and warriors blocking in front of the barracks, in their shocked eyes, from their bodies Rolled over.

The car blade, which was constantly spinning rapidly in mid-air, protruding from the center axle of the rapidly turning wheel, directly turned into a scythe of death, crossing the bodies of one person after another, directly cutting them in half, and bringing them up for a while. Blood and minced meat were splashed on the surrounding land, and then they were crushed into shards by the chariots rolling behind them.

Then, the heads of people with the same appearance were lined up in a row, and the crowds that were originally blocked in front of the camp gate, which stretched for miles, were originally noisy and buzzing.

Under such a round of chariot raids, as the torrent of steel rolled past, it turned into patches of red soil, and the uniform roar of war drums.

As for those literati and warriors, they were frightened and ran away crying, constantly pushing and shoving the people in front and around, trying to push them to the back to slow down the speed of the chariots.

The sound of crying and shouting can be heard endlessly, and there are countless people who are originally elegant, calm and calm, and look like a gentleman in a troubled world. He suddenly became the deserter refugee whom they despised and disdained in the past, and in order to save his life, he did the dirty and nasty thing of betraying his companion and causing him to die.

After such a round, the surroundings of the entire coalition barracks became stable. No one was making noise, no one was making noise, and they returned to the barracks.

However, the impact of this round of raids spread throughout the world, causing continuous condemnation.

The literati in countless places were boiling, and even the vulgar warriors they thought of in the past were also angry.

What the coalition forces have done is too much, it's fine if they don't accept those scholars and warriors who come to seek refuge. He even insulted them in every possible way, letting these elites with noble backgrounds or certain talents go with some ordinary people who are not special at all.

And after those elites protested, the coalition forces released thousands of chariots directly and ran over their flesh and blood, completely ignoring the power and class represented behind them.

This is a provocation and contempt for all landlords and powerful classes in the world, as well as an insult to cultural elites, which cannot but make them feel angry.

They have a hunch that if the coalition forces are not punished, let them understand how important the energy of these local tyrants is, which is the basis for countries to rule the region.

Then, under the attack of the kings of various countries, they will never be able to raise their heads, and can only linger on to flatter and curry favor with the kings of various countries.

Now that the monarchs of various countries see the troublesome literati and warriors in front of them being crushed so easily by the army, they will inevitably feel contempt in their hearts, thinking that the class represented by these people is vulnerable.

This idea cannot be taken seriously, and this trend cannot be encouraged.

Otherwise, it would be difficult for the powerful landlords in various places to enjoy their prosperous life today.

In the past, these ruling classes, relying on their local influence, monopolized most of the resources. Because most of the people in various places are their tenants, or their domestic slaves, all the shops and some properties in the place are taken by them for themselves.

They are the ones in charge of the economic direction of that place, and everyone is serving them.

Therefore, they who possess such energy are deeply feared and relied on by the kings of various countries.

They need these people to help them stabilize the place, help them collect taxes, and collect soldiers.

So I can only let them go, accept that their own is only in the county seat, and the rule at the township level belongs to them.

But now, the actions of the coalition forces have broken this tacit agreement.

Directly ignoring the landlord class represented by those literati, and brutally suppressing them is like suppressing those grassroots refugees without any background.

This made them feel a deep crisis, thinking that it was the crisis of the kings of various countries attacking them.

Therefore, in order to protect their own interests, as well as their own lives and property, they moved.

In the sixth year of Emperor Yuan Dynasty, at the beginning of October.

At this time, the coalition forces continued to win one victory after another on the battlefield, defeating the Qi army on the opposite side, losing land and cities one after another, in a panic.

Moreover, within two months, under the powerful and fierce offensive of the coalition forces in Jibei County in the north of Qi State, the 200,000 defenders in the territory finally couldn't hold on, and the city was destroyed and the army was defeated.

Ever since, more than 100,000 coalition troops slaughtered Jibei, enjoying the fruits of their victory as victors wantonly in this prosperous land.

Within 10 days, under the acquiescence of the chief, the entire coalition army ravaged, killed, and plundered at will. Use the wealth of the entire Jibei County to motivate their ambition to continue fighting.

Therefore, when all the coalition forces in Jibei County regrouped and were ready to attack the next target, which was Linzi County where the capital of Qi State was located, the originally prosperous and prosperous Jibei County was full of dilapidated scenes.

According to the statistics of Yan State officials who later came to take over the place and establish the rule (Jibei County has been divided into the territory of Yan State according to the agreement, in addition, there is Linzi County in the south, which is also divided into Yan State), the entire county In China, all the remaining population has changed from 700,000 before the war to less than 300,000 now, more than half of which have been lost, and most of the rest are old, weak, women and children, and very few are young and strong.

Today's Qi State has reached the moment of destruction, and it may be overthrown at any time.

Qi's domestic army is less than 500,000, and more than half of the young and strong have been lost in the previous wars. The entire army does not know if they can make up 200,000 young and strong.

But the coalition army opposite him still has a full army of about 600,000, most of whom are capable of conscripting and fighting, and it is not comparable to these Qi troops.

However, at this moment, a message came from the rear of the coalition forces. The coalition forces were greatly shaken up and down, which slowed down their extremely fierce offensive and stopped, giving Qi ample time to breathe.
